thread:
Maria R: Quick update — ran an onboarding smoke for ember-embed-3b (FP16 -> ONNX int8 per-channel) on NQ-100k testset. Seeing a Recall@1 drop of ~3.6 pts and Recall@5 ~1.2 pts. Silhouette down ~0.02. UMAP shows some banding/clumping.
Devon: Which quant flow did you use? onnxruntime static or dynamic? :thinking_face:
Maria R: onnxruntime dynamic + per-channel weight quant. activation calibration with 2048 calibration samples from train shard.
Anil: paste the eval output pls
Maria R: ```
Model,Recall@1,Recall@5,Silhouette,Median latency(ms)
ember-embed-3b-fp16,0.842,0.958,0.312,12.6
ember-embed-3b-int8,0.806,0.946,0.292,9.4
delta,-0.036,-0.012,-0.020,-3.2
``` 
Kate: ok the delta at R@1 is notable. Any per-class or query-length breakdowns?
Maria R: short queries (<=3 tokens) R@1 down ~6 pts, long queries (>20 tokens) almost unchanged. suspect quantized attention/kv precision on short dense embeddings.
Jess: did you run nearest-neighbor qualitative checks? any anchor flips?
Maria R: yes — example: query "install redwood on prem" (short) nearest fp16 -> docs/installation, int8 -> docs/architecture (semantically related but wrong top hit). pasted top-3 for that query:
```text
fp16: [installation.md, quickstart.md, infra/links.md]
int8: [architecture.md, installation.md, quickstart.md]
``` 
Devon: hmm. Could be outlier activations during first layers. Try per-channel vs per-tensor baseline? or increase calibration set size.
Anil: also try KL-divergence calibration instead of minmax. KL often stabilizes for tail activations.
Maria R: good call. I'll re-run with 20k calibration and KL. Also will run per-tensor to compare.
CI-Bot: Test run queued: https://ci.redwood/reports/3099993330/ember-int8-calib-20k
Kate: for clustering, can you share silhouette distribution (histogram) and a UMAP screenshot? helps see if a subset collapses.
Maria R: will attach in follow-up, but early UMAP shows a thin ridge for product docs cluster in int8.
Jess: any chance this is a batching artifact? were both runs using same batchsize & normalization pipeline?
Maria R: yes same preprocessing and batchsize=64. embeddings L2-normalized post-model in both.
Devon: thanks — if KL + larger calib doesn't recover R@1, next step: try per-channel but with bias-correction (float32 bias).
Anil: and evaluate on holdout harder set (NQ-hard-20k) to see if drop persists across distributions.
Maria R: plan: 1) run ONNX int8 with KL calibrate 20k (owner: Maria), 2) per-tensor baseline & per-channel+bias (owner: Devon), 3) run NQ-hard and short-query subgroup evaluations (owner: Anil). I'll post updated numbers here.
Kate: thanks — if we still see >3pt R@1 loss on short queries we should gate int8 for now and try int4 research later.
Maria R: agreed. Will report back by EOD PST. :rocket:
Devon: ping me if you want me to spin a dedicated VM to run longer calib jobs.
Maria R: will do, thx!
